vue.description: Vue 3 Sticky Parallax Scroll outer adapter wrapping @exhuma/core headless primitive.
vue.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { StickyParallaxScroll as StickyParallaxScrollPrimitive } from '@exhuma/core';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

interface Props {
  class?: string;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  class: '',
});
</script>

<template>
  <StickyParallaxScrollPrimitive
    v-bind="props"
    :class="cn('relative w-full overflow-hidden', props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </StickyParallaxScrollPrimitive>
</template>

svelte.description: Svelte 5 Sticky Parallax Scroll adapter using runes and @exhuma/core primitives.
svelte.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { StickyParallaxScroll as StickyParallaxScrollPrimitive } from '@exhuma/core';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  let {
    class: className = '',
    children,
    ...restProps
  }: {
    class?: string;
    children?: import('svelte').Snippet;
    [key: string]: unknown;
  } = $props();
</script>

<StickyParallaxScrollPrimitive
  class={cn('relative w-full overflow-hidden', className)}
  {...restProps}
>
  {@render children?.()}
</StickyParallaxScrollPrimitive>
